question: How can I make Odoo pick the smallest number of packages when fulfilling an order for a product?
answer: Enable the Packages feature, then set the product category's Force Removal Strategy to Least Packages. With this strategy, Odoo fulfills an order using the fewest number of packages [1][2]. For example, if a 100 kg package has been opened and depleted to 54 kg, an order for 14 kg picks from that opened package; an order exceeding 54 kg uses an unopened 100 kg package, and the open packages are prioritized in the next picking [1]. To verify where units were picked, on the delivery order select the bulleted list icon to open the Open: Stock move pop-up, where the Pick from field shows the source [2].

question: What do the international trade terms like EXW or CIF mean, and which ones are available in Odoo?
answer: Incoterms (International Commercial Terms) are standardized trade terms used in international transactions to define the rights and responsibilities of buyers and sellers, establishing obligations related to delivery of goods, transfer of risks, and distribution of costs between the parties [1]. They specify details such as the point at which risk and costs transfer from seller to buyer, and responsibility for transportation, insurance, customs clearance, and other aspects of the transaction [1]. By default, all 11 Incoterms are available in Odoo: EXW (Ex works), FCA (Free carrier), FAS (Free alongside ship), FOB (Free on board), CFR (Cost and freight), CIF (Cost, insurance and freight), CPT (Carriage paid to), CIP (Carriage and insurance paid to), DPU (Delivered at place unloaded), DAP (Delivered at place), and DDP (Delivered duty paid) [1].
reason: The assistant provides the correct definition of Incoterms and lists all 11 terms available in Odoo by default, fully matching the reference answer.

question: How do I renumber a batch of vendor bills so they follow a continuous sequence after importing them from my old accounting system?

Steps: 1) Activate the developer mode. 2) In the vendor bills list view, select the vendor bills that need a new sequence. 3) Click the fa-cog Actions menu and select Resequence. 4) In the Ordering field, choose either 'Keep current order' (order of numbers remains the same) or 'Reorder by accounting date' (number is reordered by accounting date). 5) Set the First New Sequence. 6) Preview Modifications and click Confirm. Note that the first vendor bill in the new sequence is highlighted in red as a permanent informational marker, and a temporary 'Gaps in the sequence' message may appear if there are irregularities. Resequencing is not possible when entries are before a lock date, when the sequence leads to a duplicate, or when the range is invalid (e.g., Bill Date doesn't align with the date in the new sequence), in which case a Validation Error appears. [1]

question: How can I make sure no VAT gets charged when my company sells to another company within the same tax group?
answer: Create a fiscal position with a tax mapping that applies a 0% tax for constituent transactions: go to Accounting > Configuration > Fiscal Positions, click Create, open the Tax Mapping tab, select the Tax on Product usually applied for non-constituent transactions, and in Tax to Apply select the 0% tax used for constituent transactions. Do the same for the Account Mapping tab if required, and repeat for each constituent company. Then assign the fiscal position: open the Contacts app, search for the constituent company, open the contact's card, go to the Sales & Purchase tab, and set the Fiscal Position field to the fiscal position created for the tax unit. Repeat for each constituent company card form on each company database. [2]

question: How can I make sure the oldest stock gets picked first when fulfilling orders, so older items don't sit around too long?
answer: To ensure the oldest stock is picked first, use the FEFO (First Expired, First Out) removal strategy, which ensures products with the nearest removal date are picked first [2]. Set the product category's Force Removal Strategy to First Expired, First Out (FEFO) and enable lots tracking [2]. When a delivery order is confirmed, the lot numbers with the soonest expiration dates are reserved using FEFO [2].

question: How do I add shipping charges to a sales order so they show up on the customer's invoice?
answer: To add shipping charges to a sales order, go to the Sales app and open the desired sales order (Sales app > Orders > Orders), then click the Add Shipping button at the bottom-right corner [1][3]. In the Add a shipping method pop-up window, choose the intended carrier in the Shipping Method field [1][3]. The Cost is automatically calculated using the weight of the items in the order, or you can click Get Rate to calculate the shipping price based on real-time shipping data [1][2]. Click Add to close the window; the delivery product then appears in the Order Lines tab with the Unit Price set as the shipping cost [1][3]. After the product is delivered, click the Create invoice button, and an invoice is created that includes the shipping cost added earlier; then click Create and View Invoice to generate a draft invoice with the shipping cost included in the Invoice Lines tab [1].

question: How can I make Odoo pick products with the closest expiration date first when fulfilling orders?

question: How does Odoo handle electronic invoicing requirements for Romania, and is it compliant with the local e-invoicing system?

It also automates VAT calculations and formats invoices to comply with Romanian VAT requirements for B2G and B2B transactions [2].

question: How do I make Odoo reserve whatever stock is available for an order instead of only reserving complete packages?
answer: Go to Inventory app > Configuration > Product Categories, then click New or select the desired product category. On the product category's form, in the Logistics section, set Reserve Packagings to Reserve Partial Packagings. Note that the Reserve Packaging field only appears if the Product Packaging feature is enabled (Inventory app > Configuration > Settings, Products section). With Reserve Partial Packagings, available units are reserved even if a full packaging cannot be filled (e.g., 22 units reserved instead of only 12 for two packagings of twelve units).
reason: The assistant provides all the necessary steps and prerequisites matching the reference answer.

question: How can I make my payments create journal entries instead of just sitting there without accounting entries?
answer: To make payments create journal entries, configure outstanding accounts for the payment method. Go to Accounting > Configuration > Journals and select or create a bank or cash journal. In the Incoming Payments and Outgoing Payments tabs, set the Outstanding Receipts accounts and Outstanding Payments accounts for each payment method that you want to create journal entries. If the outstanding receipts or outstanding payments account for a payment method is left blank, registering a payment with that payment method will not create any journal entry. [1]

question: How do I set up a rule so that a specific product gets automatically stored in a particular sub-location when it arrives in my warehouse?
answer: First, activate the Multi-Step Routes feature under Inventory app > Configuration > Settings (this also automatically activates Storage Locations), then click Save [1]. To define the rule, navigate to Inventory app > Configuration > Putaway Rules and click New to configure a new putaway rule on a Product or Product Category [1]. In the 'When product arrives in location' field, set the location where the rule is triggered (e.g., WH/Stock), and in the 'Store to' field set the destination sub-location (e.g., WH/Stock/Fruits) [1]. The Store to location must be a sub-location of the first location [1]. For example, to store all apples in the fruits section, fill the Store to field with WH/Stock/Fruits when the Product, Apple arrives in WH/Stock, then repeat for all products and hit Save [1]. Use the Sublocation field to specify whether to use a sublocation or a storage category: No (no sublocation used), Last Used (the last location with a move for that product), or Closest Location (locations from a storage category, which is mandatory in the Having Category field) [1].
reason: The assistant provides all key steps from the reference answer accurately, including enabling the required settings and configuring the putaway rule.
